description:
***Superb Town-Centre Location***

4 Saint Michael’s Court, Athy, Co. Kildare, R14 PA43 is an excellent choice for first-time buyers, growing families, or investors. This three-bedroom semi-detached family home combines a highly desirable, peaceful cul-de-sac positioning with the ultimate convenience of town-centre living.
Tucked away at the end of a quiet, private cul-de-sac, Tony Donnelly and Leonard Wilson Keenan are delighted to present this spacious property to the market. Boasting a private, un-overlooked rear garden complete with a block-built shed, this home is ready for its next chapter.
                    
Location is everything and 4 Saint Michael’s Court delivers effortlessly. Situated in the heart of Athy, the property ensures everything you need is just a short stroll away:
•	Commuter-Friendly: Within easy walking distance to Athy Train Station, providing direct and easy access for commuters.
•	Family & Education: Just minutes from excellent local primary and secondary schools.
•	Leisure & Amenities: Conveniently close to the local swimming pool, essential shops, and vibrant local sports amenities including the Athy Rugby and GAA clubs.

Bright & Spacious Accommodation

The property features a well-designed, functional layout optimized for modern family living:
Ground Floor:
•	Entrance Hallway: A bright, welcoming, and spacious entry point.

•	Sitting Room: A cosy yet generous living space featuring a real open fire.
.
•	Kitchen & Dining Area: An open-plan heart of the home, perfect for family meals and entertaining.

•	Utility Room: A highly practical separate space for laundry and additional storage.
First Floor:
•	Master Bedroom: A spacious double room complete with a private en-suite bathroom.
•	Bedrooms 2 & 3: Two additional well-proportioned bedrooms with excellent natural light.
•	Family Bathroom: A well-appointed central bathroom serving the upper floor.
Key Services & Features
•	Heating System: (Oil-Fired Central Heating & Solid Fuel open fire).
•	Utilities: Connected to mains water and mains sewage.
•	Outdoor Space: Safe, quiet cul-de-sac location with a private rear garden and a durable block-built storage shed.

Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the space, privacy, and exceptional location this town-centre gem has to offer.
